summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed a routine Form 8-K on September 8, 2026, reporting a revised 2026 annual budget of $19,500,000, driven primarily by unanticipated litigation-related legal costs. The same release announced a monthly cash distribution of $0.081790 per trust certificate, totaling approximately $6.1 million, payable September 10, 2026 to holders of record September 9, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing also references forward-looking statements regarding a proposed sale of properties, but no definitive agreement terms were stated.
